paper_id: PMID37318869 / PMC10443797 (Davey et al., JCI Insight 2023)

accessions_not_used.GSE184951: cycling-training reanalysis (Mikhail et al.), separate study

assay: bulk RNA-seq, rRNA-depleted stranded (NEBNext Ultra II Directional), PE75, vastus lateralis
sample_inclusion: 9 male DM1 patients, biopsy before and after 12-week strength training (S4.3.p1, ABS.p1)
6 male unaffected controls, single biopsy, no training (S4.3.p1)
sample_exclusion: participants 2182 and 1955 (poor RNA quantity/quality) - not deposited (S4.4.p1, S2.2.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 12-week strength training on muscle gene expression in DM1, quantified as the change from pre- to post-training relative to unaffected controls (Δlog2FC = log2FC[post vs control] - log2FC[pre vs control]) and as % rescue of pre-training DEGs; analysed grouped and per individual (S2.2.p2, S2.5.p1, S4.6.p1)

planned_contrasts.name: grouped_delta_log2FC (post-vs-control minus pre-vs-control)
planned_contrasts.test: none (difference of two fitted log2FCs; no p-value)

direct_post_vs_pre_test: not_reported (the paper never tests post vs pre within subjects)

blocking_or_covariance.note: Grouped analysis pools pre and post samples as two groups each vs controls; no subject blocking described (S2.2.p2)

matrix_scale: STAR gene counts (raw integer) -> edgeR (S4.4.p1; GEO data_processing)
paper_method: edgeR 3.34.1, quasi-likelihood F-test, each group vs unaffected controls (S4.4.p1, S4.13.p1)
paper_filter: Genes with less than 10 counts in each samples were filtered out (S4.4.p1)
normalization: not_reported (edgeR default TMM presumed, not stated)

paper_threshold.scope: significant DEGs for the strength-training program; applied in S2.5.p1 to pre-training vs unaffected-control DEGs (raw P, no multiple-testing adjustment stated)

covariates_mentioned.age: controls avg 32 vs DM1 avg 48 y; used only in correlation analysis (S2.5.p2); not in GEO metadata

case_scope: Exercise effect within DM1: post- vs pre-training, paired by subject (9 pairs)
